description: Read a card's comments, oldest first. Planka serves them 50 at a time: this returns `limit` of them (default 20) plus hasMore and nextBeforeId to continue. Use all:true to walk every page (up to 10 of them, then truncated:true). commentCount is what THIS response carries, never the card total.

all.description: Read every page instead of one (up to 10 pages). Sets truncated:true if the card has even more.

beforeId.description: Cursor: returns comments OLDER than this comment id. Pass the nextBeforeId of the previous answer.

limit.description: How many comments to return (default 20, max 50 — Planka's page size).

order.description: Reading order: "asc" (default) oldest first, the order the thread was written; "desc" newest first.

name: planka_get_comments
title: Get card comments
